pillars.heading: Your Fitness. Your Plan. Your Progress.
pillars.intro: More than a plan to follow. You get coaching to help you put it into practice.

items.title: Nutrition that fits your life
items.description: A personalised nutrition plan built around your food preferences, routine and goals, with practical guidance on portions and everyday meals.

items.title: Training that fits your schedule
items.description: A personalised home or gym workout plan matched to your experience, available equipment and time.

items.title: Coaching calls, reviews and adjustments
items.description: Regular coaching calls and progress reviews to discuss challenges, assess how your plan is working and make adjustments when needed.

items.title: WhatsApp support between reviews
items.description: Ask questions and get practical guidance when work, travel, social meals or difficult weeks make consistency harder.

items.title: Workout form and technique guidance
items.description: Appropriate exercise video references and feedback to help you understand movements and improve your technique.

perfectForYou.heading: This Programme Is for You If...
items: You struggle to stay consistent around a busy work schedule.
You have tried plans before but need help putting them into practice.
You want nutrition guidance that respects your food preferences and routine.
You want someone to review your progress, not simply send you a plan.
You are willing to practise manageable changes rather than look for a crash diet.

journey.heading: Your 12-Week Coaching Journey
journey.subheading: Here's what happens after you enrol.

steps.title: Complete your assessment
steps.description: Fill in your fitness questionnaire and share your goals, food preferences, work schedule, training experience and relevant health history.

steps.timingLabel: Within 48 hours of receiving your completed questionnaire
steps.title: Receive your personalised plans
steps.description: Receive your personalised nutrition and workout plans, along with guidance on how to get started.

steps.title: Follow, review and adjust
steps.description: Put your plans into practice with regular coaching calls, progress reviews, WhatsApp support and adjustments when needed.
supportingPoints: Build a manageable nutrition and training routine.
Review progress and work through practical obstacles.
Practise habits you can continue beyond coaching.

expectedResults.heading: What We'll Work Towards Over 12 Weeks

items.title: Sustainable fat loss and improved strength
items.description: Follow nutrition and training tailored to your starting point, goals and ability to stay consistent.

items.title: More confidence with everyday food choices
items.description: Learn practical ways to manage portions, structure meals and include foods you enjoy.

items.title: A more consistent routine
items.description: Build nutrition and workout habits that fit your work, family and social life.

expectedResults.disclaimer: Results vary depending on your starting point, consistency, training history, sleep, stress and health status. No specific amount of weight loss or physical transformation is guaranteed.

coach.heading: Meet Your Coach
bioParagraphs: I'm Asif Ali Raza, an ISSA Certified Personal Trainer and Certified Nutritionist Coach, and an INFS Certified Nutrition and Fitness Consultant.
I previously worked as a fitness consultant at HealthifyMe.
I help busy working professionals work towards sustainable fat loss through personalised nutrition, practical training and ongoing support.
My approach is evidence-based and practical. I understand your routine, build a plan you can follow, review your progress and adjust when needed, without fad diets or extreme restrictions.
